title: Refresh current Alpha release readiness
scope: Replace the stale Alpha.29 publication checklist with a concise human-facing snapshot of current GitHub, package, npm, validation, and decision gates without performing any release action.
acceptance_criteria: The document distinguishes the historical private alpha.5 prerelease, latest version tag, current package metadata, proposed next public candidate, and unpublished npm state without calling any of them a current public release.
Completed safeguards, missing candidate evidence, Human decisions, and deferred npm or enterprise qualification are visibly separated and backed by current repository or hosting observations.
No package version, repository visibility, permission, tag, GitHub Release, npm state, or external announcement changes.

profile_assessment.rationale: A reversible, evidence-backed planning-document refresh with no package or external release mutation.

overlap_resolution: WI-0086 remains the blocked historical public-Alpha candidate; WI-0149 only refreshes current readiness truth and does not reopen publication or reuse WI-0086 evidence as current qualification.
